title: Privacy Policy | Hairbygerta
description: Privacy Policy for HairByGerta.com – hair stylist & makeup artist in Staten Island, NY. Learn how we collect, use and protect your personal information online.

blocks.text: About this Privacy Policy
This Privacy Policy describes how HairByGerta.com collects, uses and protects personal information when you visit our website or contact us.
The website is operated by:

blocks.html:
Gerta Lila – Hair Stylist & Makeup Artist
Le Vigne Hair Salon
644 Forest Ave, Staten Island, NY 10310
Email: info@hairbygerta.com
Phone: 347-671-5095

blocks.text: What type of information do we collect?
We may collect the following types of personal information:

items: Name
Phone number
Email address
Preferred appointment date and time
Type of service you are interested in (haircut, color, balayage, highlights, keratin treatment, Brazilian blowout, perm, kids haircut, makeup, etc.)
Any notes you choose to send (for example, hair goals, questions, or special requests)

blocks.text: We may also collect some non-identifying information automatically, such as:

items: IP address and general location (city/region level)
Device and browser type
Pages viewed and time spent on the site
How you reached the site (for example, from a search engine or social media)

blocks.text: How do we store, use, share and disclose your information?
This website does not keep a database of visitors. Appointments are booked by phone, so this website does not collect or store any booking details.
We use your information only for the purposes listed above. We may share your information with:

items: Service providers that help us operate the website
Email or messaging services we use to send confirmations, reminders or replies
Authorities or law enforcement, if we are legally required to do so

blocks.text: These service providers are only allowed to use your information to provide services to us; they are not allowed to use it for their own marketing.
We keep your information only as long as necessary to:

items: Manage your appointments and ongoing relationship
Keep required business and tax records
Resolve any disputes

blocks.text: After that, we delete or anonymize the information.
We currently do not process online payments through this website. If we add online payments in the future, we will update this Privacy Policy.
How do we communicate with site visitors?
We may contact you using the personal information you provide to:

items: Confirm, update or remind you about appointments
Respond to your questions or requests
Send important information about changes to our services, hours or policies
Send occasional news or special offers, only if you have agreed to receive them

blocks.text: We may contact you by phone, SMS/text message, email, or any method you have provided and agreed to.
How do we use cookies and other tracking tools?
Our website uses cookies and similar technologies to:

items: Help the site function properly
Remember certain choices and preferences
Understand how visitors use the site so we can improve it

blocks.text: Cookies may be set by:

items: Google Maps, on the Contact page
Google Fonts, which provides the website’s fonts

blocks.text: These third-party services may have their own privacy and cookie policies about how they collect and store information.
You can manage cookies through your browser settings. Most browsers allow you to:

items: See which cookies are stored
Delete cookies
Block cookies or limit certain types of cookies

blocks.text: If you disable cookies, some parts of the site may not work perfectly, but you will still be able to contact us.
Questions
If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, our use of your personal information, or how to exercise your rights, please contact:

blocks.html:
Gerta Lila – Hair Stylist & Makeup Artist
Email: info@hairbygerta.com
Phone: 347-671-5095
Address: Le Vigne Hair Salon, 644 Forest Ave, Staten Island, NY 10310
